import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
from matplotlib import font_manager as _fm
def _setup_cjk_font():
    candidates = ["Microsoft YaHei", "SimHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "WenQuanYi Zen Hei",
                  "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Arial Unicode MS"]
    installed = {f.name for f in _fm.fontManager.ttflist}
    for name in candidates:
        if name in installed:
            matplotlib.rcParams["font.sans-serif"] = [name, "DejaVu Sans"]
            break
    matplotlib.rcParams["axes.unicode_minus"] = False
_setup_cjk_font()

df = pd.read_csv("nitrogen_response_demo.csv")
x_col = "week"
measures = ["control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b"]
colors = ["#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833"]

    "font.family": "SimHei",

    "axes.titlesize": 15,
    "axes.labelsize": 12.5,

    "figure.facecolor": "#FFFFFF",
    "axes.facecolor": "#FFFFFF",
    "savefig.facecolor": "#FFFFFF"
})
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 1, squeeze=False, figsize=(6.4, 4), dpi=300, layout="constrained")

axes.flat[0].tick_params(axis="x", rotation=30)
panel_titles = [""]
ax = axes.flat[0]
ax.grid(alpha=0.18)
for _i in range(len(panel_titles), len(axes.flat)):
    axes.flat[_i].set_visible(False)
fig.suptitle("改成黑白印刷友好的期刊图（箱线图）", color="#000000", fontsize=15, fontweight="bold", y=1.02)
fig.savefig("plan_clarity.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.18)
fig.savefig("plan_clarity.svg", bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.18)

# 方案二 · R / ggplot2（误差棒）
library(ggplot2)
df <- read.csv("nitrogen_response_demo.csv", check.names = FALSE)
long <- reshape(df, varying = c("control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b"), v.names = "value",
                times = c("control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b"), idvar = "week", direction = "long")
p <- ggplot(long, aes(x = .data[["week"]], y = value, color = time, group = time)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) + geom_point(size = 1.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = value - sd, ymax = value + sd), width = 0.2) +
  labs(x = "week", y = "测量值 (response)", title = "改成黑白印刷友好的期刊图（多系列折线图（误差棒））", color = NULL) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#332288", "#88CCEE", "#44AA99")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "top")

# 方案三（信息密度优先）· Python / Matplotlib（双面板：原始趋势 + 相对首点变化）
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
from matplotlib import font_manager as _fm
def _setup_cjk_font():
    candidates = ["Microsoft YaHei", "SimHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "WenQuanYi Zen Hei",
                  "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Arial Unicode MS"]
    installed = {f.name for f in _fm.fontManager.ttflist}
    for name in candidates:
        if name in installed:
            matplotlib.rcParams["font.sans-serif"] = [name, "DejaVu Sans"]
            break
    matplotlib.rcParams["axes.unicode_minus"] = False
_setup_cjk_font()

df = pd.read_csv("nitrogen_response_demo.csv")
x_col = "week"
measures = ["control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b"]
colors = ["#332288", "#88CCEE", "#44AA99"]

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10.2, 4.2), dpi=300, layout="constrained")
for i, m in enumerate(measures):
    ax1.plot(df[x_col], df[m], marker="o", linewidth=1.3, label=m, color=colors[i % len(colors)])
    base = df[m].iloc[0] if df[m].iloc[0] != 0 else 1
    ax2.plot(df[x_col], 100.0 * df[m] / base, marker="o", linewidth=1.3, label=m, color=colors[i % len(colors)])
ax1.set_title("原始趋势")
ax1.set_ylabel("测量值 (response)")
ax2.set_title("相对首点变化 (%)")
ax2.axhline(100, color="#888", linewidth=0.8, linestyle="--")
for ax in (ax1, ax2):
    ax.set_xlabel(x_col)
    ax.grid(alpha=0.2)
    ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8.5)
fig.suptitle("改成黑白印刷友好的期刊图（1×2 趋势与归一化复合图）", y=1.02)
fig.savefig("plan_density.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.18)
fig.savefig("plan_density.svg", bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.18)

library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
df <- read.csv("nitrogen_response_demo.csv", check.names = FALSE)

  scale_color_manual(values = c("#332288", "#88CCEE", "#44AA99")) + labs(title = "相对首点变化 (%)")

# 方案三（信息密度优先）· Python / Matplotlib（双面板：原始趋势 + 相对首点变化）
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
from matplotlib import font_manager as _fm
def _setup_cjk_font():
    candidates = ["Microsoft YaHei", "SimHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "WenQuanYi Zen Hei",
                  "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Arial Unicode MS"]
    installed = {f.name for f in _fm.fontManager.ttflist}
    for name in candidates:
        if name in installed:
            matplotlib.rcParams["font.sans-serif"] = [name, "DejaVu Sans"]
            break
    matplotlib.rcParams["axes.unicode_minus"] = False
_setup_cjk_font()

df = pd.read_csv("nitrogen_response_demo.csv")
x_col = "week"
measures = ["control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b"]
colors = ["#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833"]

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10.2, 4.2), dpi=300, layout="constrained")
for i, m in enumerate(measures):
    ax1.plot(df[x_col], df[m], marker="o", linewidth=1.3, label=m, color=colors[i % len(colors)])
    base = df[m].iloc[0] if df[m].iloc[0] != 0 else 1
    ax2.plot(df[x_col], 100.0 * df[m] / base, marker="o", linewidth=1.3, label=m, color=colors[i % len(colors)])
ax1.set_title("原始趋势")
ax1.set_ylabel("测量值 (response)")
ax2.set_title("相对首点变化 (%)")
ax2.axhline(100, color="#888", linewidth=0.8, linestyle="--")
for ax in (ax1, ax2):
    ax.set_xlabel(x_col)
    ax.grid(alpha=0.2)
    ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8.5)
fig.suptitle("比较三个处理组随观测周的变化趋势，生成论文用图（1×2 趋势与归一化复合图）", y=1.02)

fig.savefig("plan_density.svg", bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.18)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib

from matplotlib import font_manager as _fm
def _setup_cjk_font():
    candidates = ["Microsoft YaHei", "SimHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "WenQuanYi Zen Hei",
                  "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Arial Unicode MS"]

    matplotlib.rcParams["axes.unicode_minus"] = False
_setup_cjk_font()

df = pd.read_csv("nitrogen_response_demo.csv")

measures = ["control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b"]
colors = ["#332288", "#88CCEE", "#44AA99"]

    ax1.plot(df[x_col], df[m], marker="o", linewidth=1.3, label=m, color=colors[i % len(colors)])

    candidates = ["Microsoft YaHei", "SimHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "WenQuanYi Zen Hei",

# 方案三（信息密度优先）· Python / Matplotlib（双面板：原始趋势 + 相对首点变化）
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
from matplotlib import font_manager as _fm
def _setup_cjk_font():
    candidates = ["Microsoft YaHei", "SimHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "WenQuanYi Zen Hei",
                  "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Arial Unicode MS"]
    installed = {f.name for f in _fm.fontManager.ttflist}
    for name in candidates:
        if name in installed:
            matplotlib.rcParams["font.sans-serif"] = [name, "DejaVu Sans"]
            break
    matplotlib.rcParams["axes.unicode_minus"] = False
_setup_cjk_font()

df = pd.read_csv("nitrogen_response_demo.csv")
x_col = "week"
measures = ["control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b"]
colors = ["#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833"]

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10.2, 4.2), dpi=300, layout="constrained")
for i, m in enumerate(measures):
    ax1.plot(df[x_col], df[m], marker="o", linewidth=1.3, label=m, color=colors[i % len(colors)])
    base = df[m].iloc[0] if df[m].iloc[0] != 0 else 1
    ax2.plot(df[x_col], 100.0 * df[m] / base, marker="o", linewidth=1.3, label=m, color=colors[i % len(colors)])
ax1.set_title("原始趋势")
ax1.set_ylabel("测量值 (response)")
ax2.set_title("相对首点变化 (%)")
ax2.axhline(100, color="#888", linewidth=0.8, linestyle="--")
for ax in (ax1, ax2):
    ax.set_xlabel(x_col)
    ax.grid(alpha=0.2)
    ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8.5)
fig.suptitle("比较三个处理组随观测周的变化趋势，生成论文用图（1×2 趋势与归一化复合图）", y=1.02)
fig.savefig("plan_density.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.18)
fig.savefig("plan_density.svg", bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.18)

# 方案三 · R / ggplot2（双面板）
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
df <- read.csv("nitrogen_response_demo.csv", check.names = FALSE)
norm <- df %>% mutate(across(c("control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b"), ~ 100 * .x / first(.x)))
p1 <- ggplot(tidyr::pivot_longer(df, c("control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b")), aes(x = .data[["week"]], value, color = name)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() + scale_color_manual(values = c("#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833")) + labs(title = "原始趋势", y = "测量值 (response)")
p2 <- ggplot(tidyr::pivot_longer(norm, c("control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b")), aes(x = .data[["week"]], value, color = name)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() + geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833")) + labs(title = "相对首点变化 (%)")
ggsave("plan_density.png", patchwork::wrap_plots(p1, p2, nrow = 1), width = 10, height = 4, dpi = 300)
ggsave("plan_density.svg", patchwork::wrap_plots(p1, p2, nrow = 1), width = 10, height = 4)

# 方案三（信息密度优先）· Python / Matplotlib（双面板：原始趋势 + 相对首点变化）
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
from matplotlib import font_manager as _fm
def _setup_cjk_font():
    candidates = ["Microsoft YaHei", "SimHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "WenQuanYi Zen Hei",
                  "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Arial Unicode MS"]
    installed = {f.name for f in _fm.fontManager.ttflist}
    for name in candidates:
        if name in installed:
            matplotlib.rcParams["font.sans-serif"] = [name, "DejaVu Sans"]
            break
    matplotlib.rcParams["axes.unicode_minus"] = False
_setup_cjk_font()

df = pd.read_csv("nitrogen_response_demo.csv")
x_col = "week"
measures = ["control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b"]
colors = ["#332288", "#88CCEE", "#44AA99"]

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10.2, 4.2), dpi=300, layout="constrained")
for i, m in enumerate(measures):
    ax1.plot(df[x_col], df[m], marker="o", linewidth=1.3, label=m, color=colors[i % len(colors)])
    base = df[m].iloc[0] if df[m].iloc[0] != 0 else 1
    ax2.plot(df[x_col], 100.0 * df[m] / base, marker="o", linewidth=1.3, label=m, color=colors[i % len(colors)])
ax1.set_title("原始趋势")
ax1.set_ylabel("测量值 (response)")
ax2.set_title("相对首点变化 (%)")
ax2.axhline(100, color="#888", linewidth=0.8, linestyle="--")
for ax in (ax1, ax2):
    ax.set_xlabel(x_col)
    ax.grid(alpha=0.2)
    ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8.5)
fig.suptitle("改成黑白印刷友好的期刊图（1×2 趋势与归一化复合图）", y=1.02)
fig.savefig("plan_density.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.18)
fig.savefig("plan_density.svg", bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.18)

library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
df <- read.csv("nitrogen_response_demo.csv", check.names = FALSE)
norm <- df %>% mutate(across(c("control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b"), ~ 100 * .x / first(.x)))
p1 <- ggplot(tidyr::pivot_longer(df, c("control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b")), aes(x = .data[["week"]], value, color = name)) +

  geom_line() + geom_point() + geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#332288", "#88CCEE", "#44AA99")) + labs(title = "相对首点变化 (%)")
ggsave("plan_density.png", patchwork::wrap_plots(p1, p2, nrow = 1), width = 10, height = 4, dpi = 300)
ggsave("plan_density.svg", patchwork::wrap_plots(p1, p2, nrow = 1), width = 10, height = 4)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
from matplotlib import font_manager as _fm
def _setup_cjk_font():
    candidates = ["Microsoft YaHei", "SimHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "WenQuanYi Zen Hei",
                  "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Arial Unicode MS"]
    installed = {f.name for f in _fm.fontManager.ttflist}
    for name in candidates:
        if name in installed:
            matplotlib.rcParams["font.sans-serif"] = [name, "DejaVu Sans"]
            break
    matplotlib.rcParams["axes.unicode_minus"] = False
_setup_cjk_font()

df = pd.read_csv("nitrogen_response_demo.csv")
x_col = "week"
measures = ["control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b"]
colors = ["#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833"]
plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "SimHei",
    "font.size": 11,
    "axes.titlesize": 15,
    "axes.labelsize": 12.5,
    "xtick.labelsize": 11,
    "ytick.labelsize": 11,
    "legend.fontsize": 11,
    "figure.facecolor": "#FFFFFF",
    "axes.facecolor": "#FFFFFF",
    "savefig.facecolor": "#FFFFFF"
})
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 1, squeeze=False, figsize=(6.4, 4), dpi=300, layout="constrained")

axes.flat[0].tick_params(axis="x", rotation=30)
panel_titles = [""]
ax = axes.flat[0]
ax.grid(alpha=0.18)
for _i in range(len(panel_titles), len(axes.flat)):
    axes.flat[_i].set_visible(False)
fig.suptitle("比较三个处理组随观测周的变化趋势，生成论文用图（箱线图）", color="#000000", fontsize=15, fontweight="bold", y=1.02)

# 方案三（信息密度优先）· Python / Matplotlib（双面板：原始趋势 + 相对首点变化）
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
from matplotlib import font_manager as _fm
def _setup_cjk_font():
    candidates = ["Microsoft YaHei", "SimHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "WenQuanYi Zen Hei",
                  "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Arial Unicode MS"]
    installed = {f.name for f in _fm.fontManager.ttflist}
    for name in candidates:
        if name in installed:
            matplotlib.rcParams["font.sans-serif"] = [name, "DejaVu Sans"]
            break
    matplotlib.rcParams["axes.unicode_minus"] = False
_setup_cjk_font()

df = pd.read_csv("nitrogen_response_demo.csv")
x_col = "week"
measures = ["control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b"]
colors = ["#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833"]

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10.2, 4.2), dpi=300, layout="constrained")
for i, m in enumerate(measures):
    ax1.plot(df[x_col], df[m], marker="o", linewidth=1.3, label=m, color=colors[i % len(colors)])
    base = df[m].iloc[0] if df[m].iloc[0] != 0 else 1
    ax2.plot(df[x_col], 100.0 * df[m] / base, marker="o", linewidth=1.3, label=m, color=colors[i % len(colors)])
ax1.set_title("原始趋势")
ax1.set_ylabel("测量值 (response)")
ax2.set_title("相对首点变化 (%)")
ax2.axhline(100, color="#888", linewidth=0.8, linestyle="--")
for ax in (ax1, ax2):
    ax.set_xlabel(x_col)
    ax.grid(alpha=0.2)
    ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8.5)
fig.suptitle("比较三个处理组随观测周的变化趋势，生成论文用图（1×2 趋势与归一化复合图）", y=1.02)
fig.savefig("plan_density.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.18)
fig.savefig("plan_density.svg", bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.18)

library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
df <- read.csv("nitrogen_response_demo.csv", check.names = FALSE)
norm <- df %>% mutate(across(c("control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b"), ~ 100 * .x / first(.x)))
p1 <- ggplot(tidyr::pivot_longer(df, c("control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b")), aes(x = .data[["week"]], value, color = name)) +

  geom_line() + geom_point() + geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833")) + labs(title = "相对首点变化 (%)")
ggsave("plan_density.png", patchwork::wrap_plots(p1, p2, nrow = 1), width = 10, height = 4, dpi = 300)
ggsave("plan_density.svg", patchwork::wrap_plots(p1, p2, nrow = 1), width = 10, height = 4)

# 方案三（信息密度优先）· Python / Matplotlib（双面板：原始趋势 + 相对首点变化）
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
from matplotlib import font_manager as _fm
def _setup_cjk_font():
    candidates = ["Microsoft YaHei", "SimHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "WenQuanYi Zen Hei",
                  "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Arial Unicode MS"]
    installed = {f.name for f in _fm.fontManager.ttflist}
    for name in candidates:
        if name in installed:
            matplotlib.rcParams["font.sans-serif"] = [name, "DejaVu Sans"]
            break
    matplotlib.rcParams["axes.unicode_minus"] = False
_setup_cjk_font()

df = pd.read_csv("nitrogen_response_demo.csv")
x_col = "week"
measures = ["control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b"]
colors = ["#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833"]

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10.2, 4.2), dpi=300, layout="constrained")
for i, m in enumerate(measures):
    ax1.plot(df[x_col], df[m], marker="o", linewidth=1.3, label=m, color=colors[i % len(colors)])
    base = df[m].iloc[0] if df[m].iloc[0] != 0 else 1
    ax2.plot(df[x_col], 100.0 * df[m] / base, marker="o", linewidth=1.3, label=m, color=colors[i % len(colors)])
ax1.set_title("原始趋势")
ax1.set_ylabel("测量值 (response)")
ax2.set_title("相对首点变化 (%)")
ax2.axhline(100, color="#888", linewidth=0.8, linestyle="--")
for ax in (ax1, ax2):
    ax.set_xlabel(x_col)
    ax.grid(alpha=0.2)
    ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8.5)
fig.suptitle("比较三个处理组随观测周的变化趋势，生成论文用图（1×2 趋势与归一化复合图）", y=1.02)
fig.savefig("plan_density.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.18)
fig.savefig("plan_density.svg", bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.18)

# 方案三 · R / ggplot2（双面板）
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
df <- read.csv("nitrogen_response_demo.csv", check.names = FALSE)
norm <- df %>% mutate(across(c("control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b"), ~ 100 * .x / first(.x)))
p1 <- ggplot(tidyr::pivot_longer(df, c("control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b")), aes(x = .data[["week"]], value, color = name)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() + scale_color_manual(values = c("#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833")) + labs(title = "原始趋势", y = "测量值 (response)")
p2 <- ggplot(tidyr::pivot_longer(norm, c("control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b")), aes(x = .data[["week"]], value, color = name)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() + geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833")) + labs(title = "相对首点变化 (%)")
ggsave("plan_density.png", patchwork::wrap_plots(p1, p2, nrow = 1), width = 10, height = 4, dpi = 300)
ggsave("plan_density.svg", patchwork::wrap_plots(p1, p2, nrow = 1), width = 10, height = 4)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
from matplotlib import font_manager as _fm
def _setup_cjk_font():
    candidates = ["Microsoft YaHei", "SimHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "WenQuanYi Zen Hei",
                  "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Arial Unicode MS"]
    installed = {f.name for f in _fm.fontManager.ttflist}
    for name in candidates:
        if name in installed:
            matplotlib.rcParams["font.sans-serif"] = [name, "DejaVu Sans"]
            break
    matplotlib.rcParams["axes.unicode_minus"] = False
_setup_cjk_font()

df = pd.read_csv("nitrogen_response_demo.csv")
x_col = "week"
measures = ["control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b"]
colors = ["#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833"]

    "font.family": "SimHei",

library(ggplot2)
df <- read.csv("nitrogen_response_demo.csv", check.names = FALSE)
long <- reshape(df, varying = c("control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b"), v.names = "value",
                times = c("control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b"), idvar = "week", direction = "long")
p <- ggplot(long, aes(x = .data[["week"]], y = value, color = time, group = time)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) + geom_point(size = 1.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = value - sd, ymax = value + sd), width = 0.2) +
  labs(x = "week", y = "测量值 (response)", title = "改成黑白印刷友好的期刊图（多系列折线图（误差棒））", color = NULL) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#332288", "#88CCEE", "#44AA99")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "top")
ggsave("plan_convention.png", p, width = 6.8, height = 4.6, dpi = 300)
ggsave("plan_convention.svg", p, width = 6.8, height = 4.6)

# 方案三（信息密度优先）· Python / Matplotlib（双面板：原始趋势 + 相对首点变化）
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
from matplotlib import font_manager as _fm
def _setup_cjk_font():
    candidates = ["Microsoft YaHei", "SimHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "WenQuanYi Zen Hei",
                  "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Arial Unicode MS"]
    installed = {f.name for f in _fm.fontManager.ttflist}
    for name in candidates:
        if name in installed:
            matplotlib.rcParams["font.sans-serif"] = [name, "DejaVu Sans"]
            break
    matplotlib.rcParams["axes.unicode_minus"] = False
_setup_cjk_font()

df = pd.read_csv("nitrogen_response_demo.csv")
x_col = "week"
measures = ["control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b"]
colors = ["#332288", "#88CCEE", "#44AA99"]

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10.2, 4.2), dpi=300, layout="constrained")
for i, m in enumerate(measures):
    ax1.plot(df[x_col], df[m], marker="o", linewidth=1.3, label=m, color=colors[i % len(colors)])
    base = df[m].iloc[0] if df[m].iloc[0] != 0 else 1
    ax2.plot(df[x_col], 100.0 * df[m] / base, marker="o", linewidth=1.3, label=m, color=colors[i % len(colors)])
ax1.set_title("原始趋势")
ax1.set_ylabel("测量值 (response)")
ax2.set_title("相对首点变化 (%)")
ax2.axhline(100, color="#888", linewidth=0.8, linestyle="--")
for ax in (ax1, ax2):
    ax.set_xlabel(x_col)
    ax.grid(alpha=0.2)
    ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8.5)
fig.suptitle("改成黑白印刷友好的期刊图（1×2 趋势与归一化复合图）", y=1.02)
fig.savefig("plan_density.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.18)
fig.savefig("plan_density.svg", bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.18)

# 方案三 · R / ggplot2（双面板）
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
df <- read.csv("nitrogen_response_demo.csv", check.names = FALSE)
norm <- df %>% mutate(across(c("control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b"), ~ 100 * .x / first(.x)))
p1 <- ggplot(tidyr::pivot_longer(df, c("control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b")), aes(x = .data[["week"]], value, color = name)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() + scale_color_manual(values = c("#332288", "#88CCEE", "#44AA99")) + labs(title = "原始趋势", y = "测量值 (response)")
p2 <- ggplot(tidyr::pivot_longer(norm, c("control", "treatment_a", "treatment_b")), aes(x = .data[["week"]], value, color = name)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() + geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#332288", "#88CCEE", "#44AA99")) + labs(title = "相对首点变化 (%)")
ggsave("plan_density.png", patchwork::wrap_plots(p1, p2, nrow = 1), width = 10, height = 4, dpi = 300)
ggsave("plan_density.svg", patchwork::wrap_plots(p1, p2, nrow = 1), width = 10, height = 4)
